title: CWE-307: Improper Restriction of Excessive Authentication Attempts
content: The software does not properly restrict the number of consecutive failed authentication attempts that an entity can make, which makes it easier for attackers to execute automated credential guessing or brute force attacks. When authentication endpoints do not limit attempt velocity, automated tools can submit thousands of credential combinations. Recommended mitigations include enforcing IP-based and user-account rate limiting, triggering progressive delays (exponential backoff) after consecutive failures, implementing account lockout thresholds, and deploying CAPTCHA verification challenges when unusual authentication velocity is detected.
